Meeting Date:                 4/27/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Scott, Jr. (24)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 4-J at 1950 S Kedzie Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-J in the
area bound by:

      the alley next west of and parallel to South Kedzie Avenue; a line 125 feet north of and
      parallel to West 21*' Street; South Kedzie Avenue; and a line 100 feet north of and
      parallel to West 21*' Street,

to those of a B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          MJchaerScott Jr.
                                                          Alderman, 24"" Ward




Common Address:
1950 S. Kedzie Avenue
